description: Spans around a block child sit in the anonymous blocks beside it, each with its own box.

florui.css: .p { width: 260px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .blk { height: 20px; background-color: #ffd54a; } .s { background-color: #c0e8ff; padding: 0 4px; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 2.08% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 7.50% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
